documentation_excerpts.text: Resolve conflicts from any git operation (rebase, merge, cherry-pick, revert) with intelligent handling of lock files, migrations, mergiraf-supported languages, and stacked PR duplicates.
- No arguments: detect context, resolve conflicts, continue the operation - `--abort`: abort the current operation - `--continue`: skip resolution, just run the appropriate continue command

- `/resolve-conflicts` -- detect context, resolve conflicts, continue - `/resolve-conflicts --abort` -- abort current rebase/merge/cherry-pick/revert - `/resolve-conflicts --continue` -- continue without resolving (e.g., after manual edits)
